title: No need for House to recall 2027 budget bill, says Gatchalian, Lacson

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian and Sen. Panfilo Lacson said there is no need for the House of Representatives to recall its 2027 General Appropriations Bill (GAB) as a response to the recent Supreme Court ruling, which declared unconstitutional key provisions of the last 2024 to 2026 national budgets. Gatchalian shared that recalling the House GAB would not be necessary as only a few of its provisions may be covered by the SC decision. “Not necessary naman dahil papasok na kami sa consolidation ng budget dito so we can do the correction ourselves.
